content: | F11 | Joined screens receive by themselves | S | US18. A print dropped into a joined space is fetched by every joined device without a drag. Fetching by itself only starts once a join has settled: a mini-map join is settled when it is accepted, a join-tab join when its 10-second Undo window has passed with no Undo. Only prints dropped after the join settled are fetched by themselves. Prints from before need a tap. "Received" is not "saved": photos wait in the app until saved. Only prints from devices in the same joined group are fetched this way. Files over 20 MB wait for a tap |
